title: 1965 AHSME Problem 16
statement: Let line \(AC\) be perpendicular to line \(CE.\) Connect \(A\) to the midpoint \(D\) of \(CE,\) and connect \(E\) to the midpoint \(B\) of \(AC.\) If \(AD\) and \(EB\) intersect in point \(F,\) and \(BC=CD=15\) inches, then the area of triangle \(DFE,\) in square inches, is:

solutions.text:
Put \(C=(0,0),\ A=(0,30),\) and \(E=(30,0).\) Then \(B=(0,15)\) and \(D=(15,0).\) Lines \(AD\) and \(EB\) are medians of triangle \(ACE,\) so they meet at the centroid \(F=(10,10).\) Segment \(DE\) has length \(15\) and \(F\) is \(10\) units above its line. Therefore \[[DFE]=\frac12(15)(10)=75.\]

Thus, the correct answer is C.
hints: Since \(B,D\) are midpoints and \(BC=CD=15,\) both perpendicular legs have length \(30\)
